assessments.reasoning: The official SAP Release 754 Access Control topic explicitly assigns DEFINE ROLE to CDS DCL and says each CDS role has a separate DCL source. Its distinction from other source types and the classic role-editor notes support the source boundary.

challenge.method: Compare the DEFINE ROLE paragraph with the separate-source requirement, the editor distinctions, and the Notes on classic authorization to test whether multiple roles or other source forms satisfy this declaration as stated.
challenge.results: The controlling page explicitly provides one DCL source per CDS role, distinguishes DCL from the DDL source types, and gives classic authorization its own mechanism. No runtime authorization effect is claimed.

limitations: This is the documented role declaration and source organization. Runtime access control, rule composition and all platform-specific authorization behavior are outside the claim.
